title: Cache
sub: Keeps pages fast. The stock shown on pages is for display only: adding to the bag and the checkout always check the live stock.

kpi.here: this server process only (Redis is not connected)

safe.title: Add to bag and checkout always check the live stock.
safe.text: The kept stock number is only for showing on pages, so nothing is ever sold twice.

times.title: How long each layer keeps a page
times.desc: Shorter = changes show faster; longer = faster pages. Saving a product or a setting clears its own pages by itself.
times.server: The server keeps category and product pages
times.cdn: Cloudflare keeps category and product pages too
times.cdnHint: Off by default. Turn it on only after the Cloudflare cache rule in the guide is set and the Cloudflare token is in Keys & connections.
times.filesHint: Browser + Cloudflare · a changed file gets a new name
times.maxEntries: Pages one server process keeps at most
times.saved: Saved — shown in the audit log
times.readOnly: You can see these times. Changing them needs the "Cache" key (system.cache).

rules.title: When the cache is cleared by itself
rules.sub: A wrong cache shows a wrong price — these rules are always on.
rules.priceText: That product, its category pages and Cloudflare are cleared at once
rules.stockText: Cleared at once — sold out shows sold out
rules.settingText: Every page that may use it is cleared
rules.productText: Its category pages and the sitemap are cleared
rules.neverText: Every customer always sees his own bag, checkout and account, fresh.

layers.title: The four layers
layers.sub: From the customer's phone back to the server.
layers.browserLong: A long time — a changed file gets a new name
layers.cdnKeeps: Images and, when switched on, public pages
layers.cdnLong: Images long, pages a few minutes
layers.serverLong: Minutes — new the moment something on them changes
layers.redisKeeps: Clears passed between the server's processes, hit counts; settings and the area list are kept until they change

clear.title: Clear every cache?

effects.pages: Every server process drops the pages it keeps; they are built fresh on the next visit
effects.slow: For a few minutes the shop can be a little slower
effects.cdn: Cloudflare is asked to drop what it keeps (practice only until its token is in)
effects.safe: Nothing is lost: orders, products and settings are not touched

clear.done: All cache cleared — pages are built fresh
clear.doneCdn: Cleared here; Cloudflare did not answer — try again in a minute

errors.STALE: Someone else changed these times. The page shows the new ones; change them again if you still want to.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: One of the times is not an offered choice.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
